summary: Simon Property Group, L.P., an Indianapolis REIT operating partnership, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an $800 million two-tranche senior notes offering under an existing shelf. The deal comprises $400 million of 5.250% notes due February 15, 2032, priced at 99.995% (0.350% underwriting discount), and $400 million of 5.650% notes due October 1, 2036, priced at 99.800% (0.450% discount), settling book-entry only via DTC on or about September 16, 2026. Notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, rank pari passu, and are optionally redeemable with a make-whole provision before January 15, 2032 and July 1, 2036 respectively. J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, PNC, and Wells Fargo lead. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch issuance spreads and rate sensitivity.
